notes: PD: mid-market B2B SaaS (search product embedded in team collaboration app). Primary need: improved top-k relevance for query -> candidate rerank flow.
Current infra: BM25 + lightweight learning-to-rank. Baseline metrics: MRR ~0.34, NDCG@10 ~0.42 — goal: +10-15% relative lift.

POC scope (agreed): 1) hosted API for quick iteration (2-week fast cycle); 2) Dedicated sizing conversation if hosted meets acceptance. Deliverables: rerank-only endpoint, offline scoring batch, eval dashboard.

Evaluation set: 10k production queries sampled (long-tail emphasis), 5 human annotators for relevance labels, blind A/B vs BM25. Metrics: MRR, NDCG@10, click-simulated metrics. Acceptance: >=12% MRR lift OR consistent qualitative improvement + <=1.2x cost target.
Perf / SLA asks: online rerank latency target p95 <= 120ms (prefer p95 <100ms) for top-10 rerank; throughput pilot ~150-300 QPS; offline scoring ~2M docs/day for nightly refresh.

Integration notes: they will send candidate document metadata + embeddings to rerank endpoint. Must support passing precomputed embeddings, structured score outputs, and per-request model pin/version. Also need per-route token and cost telemetry.

Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML for console, audit logs retention 1 year, KMS integration for key management. Data residency: prefer NA regions; security team wants dedicated VPC for Dedicated stage.

Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget-conscious. Want clear unit economics: cost per query target <$0.02 (including candidate scoring). Comparing Redwood Dedicated cost vs. spinning extra infra in-house; CFO will weigh.

Model preferences: prefer open/instruction-tuned models or Redwood-verified variants. Interested in quantized endpoints and fallback model (smaller) for low-priority queries. Want ability to A/B/rollout easily.
SE notes from demo: rerank endpoint supports batch offline scoring, candidate-only payloads, and integrated eval harness. Need to confirm exportable eval results (CSV + Kibana dashboard).
Quote from product lead: "We need predictable latency under load — if we can hit p95 <120ms with better NDCG, it's worth moving to Dedicated."

POC acceptance criteria (storage in Drive): - >=12% MRR lift over BM25 OR clear per-intent wins; - p95 latency <=120ms at pilot QPS; - offline batch completes within nightly window; - security checklist items green.
Open questions: exact peak QPS during promotional periods (affects Dedicated sizing), retention window for logs (security price impact), demo of auto-fallback to cheaper model under load.
